data.long_meaning: The meaning of Minerva is recorded in name-lists as “Goddess of Wisdom and Arts”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minerva total 37, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Μινέρβα
in_greek.meaning: Θεά της Σοφίας και του Πολέμου
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Μινέρβα είναι η Θεά της Σοφίας και του Πολέμου στην ρωμαϊκή μυθολογία, αλλά δεν έχει άμεση σημασία στην χριστιανική παράδοση, παρά μόνο πολιτιστική επιρροή

in_latin.name: Minerva
